series_cards.title: The First Series · 2027
series_cards.body: The inaugural series. Natural white diamonds of the house standard, serial-numbered from N° 006 — the lowest numbers are reserved to the archive. The series that opens the book.

series_cards.title: The Black Diamond Series
series_cards.body: Natural black diamonds — the diamond that absorbs all light. A closed, numbered series following the First Series. The house favors platinum; the setting is the owner's choice. Its number, year, and covenants publish before the first stone.

series_cards.title: Declared series to come
series_cards.body: The Argo Sapphire (including padparadscha), The Argo Ruby, and The Argo Spinel — each a closed, numbered series of natural stones. The Argo Alexandrite is under consideration. Each series opens when its covenants are published here.
